summary: benaadams 提交 EIP-8223，新增一种由目标合约（`tx.to`）通过付费方注册表预部署合约支付 gas 的赞助交易类型。prestwich 把 EIP-8164 原生密钥委托的后量子签名方案从 Ed25519 换成 NIST 标准化的 ML-DSA-44，当天提交并合并。gakonst 认为不能再靠新增 AA EIP 解决钱包问题，生态需要为钱包用户做出决定并写进 EIP。jessepollak 宣布 Base 将引入隐私。

items.title: EIP-8164：用 ML-DSA-44（FIPS 204）替换 Ed25519
items.note: （prestwich）提交并合并：EOA 原生密钥委托的后量子签名方案改为 NIST 标准化方案，并相应更新密钥大小、签名大小与预编译 gas。
items.note_en: (prestwich), submitted and merged: native key delegation for EOAs now uses the NIST standardized post-quantum scheme, with key sizes, signature sizes and precompile gas updated to match.
items.topic_en: Accounts: sponsored transactions and native keys

items.topic: 账户：赞助交易与原生密钥
items.title: EIP-7932：支持公钥与签名分离
items.note: （SirSpudlington）合并：secp256k1 的算法类型改为 `0x0`，限制大于 126 的算法类型，增加 `merge_detached_signature`，并修复与 secp256k1 的公钥冲突。
items.title_en: EIP-7932: add support for public key and signature separation
items.note_en: (SirSpudlington), merged: secp256k1 moves to algorithm type `0x0`, types above 126 are restricted, `merge_detached_signature` is added and a public key collision with secp256k1 is fixed.

summary_en: benaadams submitted EIP-8223, a sponsored transaction type where gas is charged to the target contract (`tx.to`) through a payer registry predeploy. prestwich switched EIP-8164 native key delegation from Ed25519 to NIST standardized ML-DSA-44, submitted and merged the same day. gakonst argued that more AA EIPs will not fix wallets and the ecosystem must make decisions for wallet users and enforce them in an EIP. jessepollak announced that Base is bringing privacy.
